cards.ex: The construction work next door is creating a jarring noise all day long.
cards.exUz: Qo'shnidagi qurilish maydonchasi kun bo'yi yoqimsiz shovqin chiqarmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qulog'ingizga yoqmaydigan, bezovta qiluvchi shovqin.

cards.ex: The explosion deafened his ears for a few seconds.
cards.exUz: Portlash bir necha soniya davomida uning quloqlarini qomatga keltirdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda baland ovoz bilan kimningdir qulog'ini og'ritmoq.

cards.ex: The constant drone of the air conditioner was driving me crazy.
cards.exUz: Konditsionerning uzluksiz g'uvillashi meni aqldan ozdirayozgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Uzluksiz va zerikarli bir xil ovoz.

cards.ex: A burst of laughter erupted from the room next door.
cards.exUz: Qo'shni xonadan kulgu portlashi eshitildi.
cards.uzDef: Birdaniga va kuchli kulgu ovozi.

cards.ex: The referee blew a piercing whistle to stop the game.
cards.exUz: Hakam o'yinni to'xtatish uchun o'tkir hushtak chaldi.
cards.uzDef: O'tkir, baland va bezovta qiluvchi hushtak ovozi.

cards.ex: The children were chattering away excitedly about their trip.
cards.exUz: Bolalar sayohat haqida hayajon bilan vaysashardi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va uzluksiz ravishda, ko'p gapirmoq.

cards.ex: A cacophony of voices filled the market square.
cards.exUz: Bozor maydonini turli xil ovozlar g'alayoni qopladi.
cards.uzDef: Tartibsiz va yoqimsiz turli xil ovozlar aralashmasi.

cards.ex: The thick curtains helped to dampen the sound from the street.
cards.exUz: Qalin pardalar ko'cha shovqinini susaytirishga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Ovozning kuchini kamaytirish yoki yutish.

cards.ex: I heard a muffled sound coming from the basement.
cards.exUz: Men yerto'ladan bo'g'iq ovoz eshitdim.
cards.uzDef: Aniqligi kamaygan, xira ovoz.

cards.ex: The actor has a wonderfully resonant voice.
cards.exUz: Aktyorning ajoyib jarangdor ovozi bor.
cards.uzDef: Chuqur va jarangdor, yoqimli ovoz.

cards.ex: The incessant noise from the construction site made it impossible to concentrate.
cards.exUz: Qurilish maydonchasidan kelayotgan tinoqsiz shovqin diqqatni jamlashni imkonsiz qildi.
cards.uzDef: To'xtovsiz davom etadigan shovqin.

cards.ex: The old machinery emitted a high-pitched whine.
cards.exUz: Eski uskunalar ingichka vishillash chiqardi.
cards.uzDef: Juda baland va yoqimsiz vishillash ovozi.

cards.ex: We couldn't hear each other speak over the din of traffic.
cards.exUz: Transport shovqini tufayli bir-birimizning gapimizni eshita olmadik.
cards.uzDef: Transport vositalaridan keladigan baland va tartibsiz shovqin.

cards.ex: A hushed reverence fell over the crowd as the ceremony began.
cards.exUz: Marosim boshlanishi bilan olomonni jim hurmat qamrab oldi.
cards.uzDef: Ovozsiz va chuqur hurmat, odatda muqaddas joylarda.

cards.ex: The grating sound of chalk on the blackboard made me cringe.
cards.exUz: Doskada bo'rning qirqillagan ovozi meni titroqqa soldi.
cards.uzDef: Qulog'ga yoqimsiz, qirqillagan yoki ishqalanuvchi ovoz.

cards.ex: The soothing melody helped me relax after a stressful day.
cards.exUz: Yuvosh kuy stressli kundan keyin dam olishimga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Tinchlantiruvchi, yoqimli va dam beruvchi kuy.

cards.ex: His powerful speech resonated with the audience.
cards.exUz: Uning kuchli nutqi tinglovchilarga munosabat bildirdi.
cards.uzDef: Ovoz yoki g'oya bilan hamohang bo'lish, o'ziga xos ta'sir ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: I could hear his rumbling stomach from across the table.
cards.exUz: Men uning qornining g'uldirashini stolning narigi tomonidan eshitdim.
cards.uzDef: Ochlikdan qorinda paydo bo'ladigan ovoz.

cards.ex: The singer held a sustained note at the end of the song.
cards.exUz: Qo'shiqchi qo'shiqning oxirida uzoq notani ushlab turdi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida ushlab turilgan nota.

cards.ex: The traffic jam was accompanied by a cacophony of car horns.
cards.exUz: Trafik tiqilishi mashina signallari galayoni bilan birga edi.
cards.uzDef: Tartibsiz va baland mashina signallarining yoqimsiz aralashmasi.

cards.ex: She finally piped up with her opinion after everyone else had spoken.
cards.exUz: U nihoyat boshqalar gapirgandan keyin o'z fikrini aytdi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmaganda gapirishni boshlash, ko'pincha norasmiy tarzda.

cards.ex: I could hear the whir of the helicopter blades overhead.
cards.exUz: Men tepada vertolyot pichoqlarining shovqinini eshitdim.
cards.uzDef: Aylanayotgan pichoqlardan keladigan tez, aylanish ovozi.

cards.ex: The orchestra produced a discordant sound when the musicians weren't in tune.
cards.exUz: Orkestr sozandalar mos kelmaganda nosoz ovoz chiqardi.
cards.uzDef: Bir-biriga mos kelmaydigan, yoqimsiz ovoz.

cards.ex: I heard the rustling sound of someone walking through the leaves.
cards.exUz: Men kimdir barglar orasidan yurganining shivirlovchi ovozini eshitdim.
cards.uzDef: Yengil, quruq narsalarning bir-biriga ishqalanishidan kelib chiqadigan ovoz.

cards.ex: The jarring contrast between the old and new buildings was striking.
cards.exUz: Eski va yangi binolar orasidagi keskin farq hayratlanarli edi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan va yoqimsiz farq.

cards.ex: In a large meeting, it can be difficult to make yourself heard.
cards.exUz: Katta yig'ilishda o'zingizni eshittirish qiyin bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Fikringizga e'tibor qaratishga harakat qiling.

cards.ex: We heard a piercing cry coming from the forest.
cards.exUz: Biz o'rmondan kelayotgan o'tkir qichqiriqni eshitdik.
cards.uzDef: Baland, keskin va bezovta qiluvchi qichqiriq.

cards.ex: There was a steady hum coming from the refrigerator.
cards.exUz: Muzlatgichdan doimiy g'uvillash kelayotgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy, past va bir xil ovoz.

cards.ex: The speaker was met with a burst of applause after his speech.
cards.exUz: Notiq nutqidan so'ng olqishlar portlashi bilan kutib olindi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmaganda va baland olqishlar.

cards.ex: The floorboards made a hollow sound when I stepped on them.
cards.exUz: Men qadam bosganimda taxtalar bo'sh ovoz chiqardi.
cards.uzDef: Ichida bo'shliq borligini ko'rsatadigan past va g'alati ovoz.
